authority: English Harpoon V 2026-01-01, PDF74/printed 6-6 section 6.3.9: Beyond LOS is the range for a TDL's high frequency (HF) radio transmissions that can be detected by ES systems.

rts_policy.scope: committed TDL HF radio transmissions only; the printed sentence covers TDL data links, voice-over-HF stays pending null
rts_policy.receiver: every HF-ES receiver is an explicit scenario_assumption fit (exact unit name + fitted sensor id + declared range_nm + bearing_error_deg); absent declaration means no HF-ES capability and no ES hardware is claimed to support HF by default
rts_policy.extent: deterministic detection inside the declared receiver range_nm; the rule prints no chance/range, so no probability table exists or may be invented
rts_policy.currency: strict actual current sending tick: an emission is an ES source only at queued_at == w.tick; a committed message is not continuous radiation, no 180-second window is implied, and a late receiver never detects a historical pulse
rts_policy.report: bearing-only: true receiver-to-emission-position bearing plus the declared bearing_error_deg as reported uncertainty; no measured position, no fix, no category, no class, no FCS, no quality and no contact bonus are produced by this leaf; the public view carries bearing/error/observation time/own sensor only, while the emitter identity and message reference stay in the referee trace
rts_policy.hardware_gate: the declared sensor must actually be fitted and undamaged on the receiver at the sample (real damage-runtime sensor gate rechecked every sample)
rts_policy.producer_dependency: communications2026 Message.hf_emitter_position / hf_transmissions committed at queue time
rts_policy.wiring: Context field, fingerprint, parent module declaration and the detection2026 Receiver::Es integration are root-owned; this leaf is pure over World + Configuration

scenario_assumption_receivers.source: scenario_assumption: explicit batch experimental HF-ES receiver; no real Annex ES hardware HF claim

real ES hardware HF support (blocked: no real annex entry, no real ES HF fit in DB)
